fields.summary: The plan step of a plan run on change set 8 of milestone 3 (ship-change on Rhiza's workflows), 2026-10-27. Starting from the settled milestone-3 decisions (four-workflows, two-owner-gates, engine-is-conductor, autonomous-mode, review-workflow-shape), the build and review change sets' planned leaves (the leaves and checks step kinds, rhiza run summary, review's sign-off with rhiza run approve and request-changes) and today's ship-change.toml (a /shipit:go agent step, then wait, check, rebase, land, merge and close-out steps), the planner put two topics to the owner through AskUserQuestion, each with a recommendation; the owner picked the recommended option every time. Settled: (1) ship-change runs build and review through a new `workflow` step kind that runs another workflow's steps inside the same run and journal, so repo overrides of build or review apply when shipping; (2) the PR opens before the owner's sign-off: build, then review's checks without review's own sign-off, then push and open the PR with rhiza run summary as its body, wait for CI, then ship-change's own sign-off, then rebase, land and merge as today; (3) request-changes at that sign-off runs one fix cycle as in review, re-runs only the failed checks, pushes, updates the PR body, waits for CI and returns to the sign-off; (4) a failing CI check fails the run as today, to be fixed and resumed; (5) the shipit path is replaced, not kept, and a change set without leaves is refused at run start, pointing to the plan workflow. No answer was typed, so there are no owner quotes; the picks are captured as Decisions by session interview; the leaves link the landed milestone-3 decisions.
fields.title: ship-change on Rhiza's workflows, planned with the owner
